Two rotations, `primary` and `secondary`, with the same three members and a `distinct` link between them from the start, built by weekly runs over three months. At equal starts `primary` is decided first because it is named first in the link, so it runs plain round robin alice, bob, carol; `secondary` may never give the week to the member holding `primary`, so it runs one step behind (bob, carol, alice), which is visible in both snapshots (primary alice 35, bob 35, carol 28; secondary bob 35, carol 35, alice 28). After the snapshot the pattern continues: 09-14 alice/bob, 09-21 bob/carol, 09-28 carol/alice. The `#All shifts` view in `expected/status.txt` shows that no member appears twice at the same start. The `#Links` tab is written back unchanged.
